newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat moves up as currency ignored.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat moves up as currency ignored.

text.p: LIFFE wheat reversed recent currency-induced losses to end mostly one stg higher.
The strength of sterling, which had set the tone in recent days, played little part, traders said.
"The market had got low enough," one trader said. Shippers had moved to take profits and they were still prepared to buy at the closing levels.
November was most active and had the biggest rise. It last traded 1.25 stg up at 83.00 stg. Volume on November was 173 lots of a total 327.
Barley also firmed, with November last traded 0.75 stg higher at 79.25 stg on volume of 18 of a total 23 lots.
Physical market prices in contrast carried on down, losing around one stg in subdued trade.
